messages:
mina: Heads-up from an early customer: RN app keeps retrying auth refresh in a loop when SDK does automatic token refresh. Happens only on Expo Go.
sam: Do we use fetch + AbortController for retries? RN fetch/AbortController behavior differs from browsers.
mina: Yes, we abort on timeout and then kick off a refresh + retry flow. On Hermes the aborted request still triggers server side and token gets rotated twice.
oliver: Could be that RN's fetch doesn't reliably cancel underlying socket, so server sees two requests. Our auth retry assumes cancellation stops request.
jess: Workarounds: detect platform and avoid using AbortController for RN; instead implement client-side timeout and ignore late responses. Or add an idempotency token to requests so duplicate retries are safe.
sam: We should also document behavior and add an SDK config option: { preferNativeAbort: false } or something to opt out. For Expo Go note about unreliable AbortController.
mina: Also found that when using our ESM package, Metro picks up dist/index.mjs and we hit missing node shims; switching package.json to include "react-native": "dist/rn/index.js" solved the bundle issue for RN and made our RN-specific retry change easier to ship.
ojess: (typo) jess: Good call. For typings, recommend AsyncIterable<T> for streaming responses instead of Node.Readable to avoid TS errors in RN projects.
dev-bot: RFC #248 reminder: sdk-rn-entrypoints draft due in 5 days (owner: @jess).
